lines.t: My son, do not worry because you do not have all the answers, nor be upset because you do not fully understand.
For The Lord your God is Truth,
For all knowledge resides within The Father, even as I am in The Father and He is in Me. Thus I am also The Answer.
and you shall be set free;
For it is the humble, penitent man who shall see God;
Behold, he shall look upon My face,
As I restore him in My image...
For I am the image of The Invisible God,
The perfect reflection of The Father,
The face of The Majesty from on high,
Therefore open your heart to Me,
And I shall create you anew...
